chapters.title: Hosea's marriage
chapters.summary: God tells Hosea to marry Gomer, who will be unfaithful, as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness to God. Their children's names announce judgment, yet hope remains.

chapters.title: I will allure her
chapters.summary: God will strip unfaithful Israel, then lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her, and she will call Him "my husband".

chapters.title: Hosea buys back his wife
chapters.summary: God tells Hosea to love his wife again and buy her back, as He loves Israel. Afterward they will return and seek the Lord.

chapters.title: Lack of knowledge
chapters.summary: There is no faithfulness or knowledge of God in the land. My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge, and the priests share the blame.

chapters.title: Judgment on leaders
chapters.summary: Priests, people and king are all guilty. Israel looks to Assyria, but God will withdraw until they seek His face.

chapters.title: Mercy, not sacrifice
chapters.summary: Come, let us return to the Lord. But Israel's love is like morning mist. God desires mercy and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

chapters.title: A half-baked cake
chapters.summary: Israel is like a cake not turned and a silly dove, flying to Egypt and Assyria instead of returning to God.

chapters.title: Sow the wind
chapters.summary: Israel made kings and idols without God. They sow the wind and will reap the whirlwind.

chapters.title: No more joy
chapters.summary: Israel's festivals will end in exile because they have been unfaithful. Their glory will fly away like a bird.

chapters.title: Break up your fallow ground
chapters.summary: Israel is a luxuriant vine that built many altars. Sow righteousness, reap mercy, break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek the Lord.

chapters.title: When Israel was a child
chapters.summary: When Israel was a child I loved him and called My son out of Egypt. I led them with cords of love. How can I give you up?

chapters.title: Jacob's story
chapters.summary: Like their ancestor Jacob, Israel must return to God, hold fast to love and justice, and wait on Him continually.

chapters.title: Death, where are your plagues?
chapters.summary: Israel turned to idols and forgot the God who cared for them. Yet God will ransom them from the grave: O death, I will be your plagues.

chapters.title: Return to the Lord
chapters.summary: Hosea calls Israel to return with words of repentance. God promises to heal their backsliding and love them freely; He will be like dew to Israel.
